name: vn-company-formation
description: How to form a company in Vietnam in 2026 and what follows for tax. Use for the choice between a single-member LLC, a multi-member LLC (2 to 50 members), a joint-stock company (at least 3 shareholders) and a private enterprise, enterprise registration (decision in 3 working days), the 90-day capital contribution rule and the 30-day charter capital adjustment, beneficial owner information under Law 76/2025/QH15, the end of the business licence fee from 1 January 2026, and the first tax steps (CIT exemptions for new SMEs and very small companies). Tier 2, not reviewed by an accountant.
